cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for apologising for missing my concert. I taught you to own a mistake without waiting for someone to drag it out of you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're naming the mistake now; good. But I had to ask whether you'd even noticed. You left me waiting all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with that. 'I left you waiting because I was afraid to speak.' No hiding behind the missed train this time; say you're sorry for the week after it.
